name: allrigs_dino3b16_s123.pt
model: frozen dinov3_vitb16 (models_pretrained/dinov3/dinov3_vitb16_pretrain_lvd1689m-73cec8be.pth, sha256 73cec8be7427c865..., timm 1.0.29) -> cls_mean readout -> L2 logistic-regression head at C=0.1. This .pt holds only the head and the backbone's identity; the backbone is loaded from models_pretrained/ and checked against that digest.
why_this_one: First frozen-DINOv3 ship candidate (docs/dinov3_integration_plan.md §9.1), prepared on 2026-09-27 at the owner's request AHEAD of the §7.2 adoption decision -- not deployed, and not to be deployed until that decision (12 paired fold x seed deltas vs the ResNet18 seed 123/7 sweep exp232-239) and the §9.3 OOD re-validation are done. Backbone and readout were chosen by the folds (owner selected ViT-B/16 on exp240-251: cross-camera patch macro-F1 0.8873, photo-pooled 0.9489, vs the fine-tuned ResNet18 recipe's 0.8025 at seed 42); C=0.1 is the lower median of those twelve folds' own val picks. Of the three all-cameras seeds (exp252/253/254, same C), seed 123 leads on val macro-F1 (0.9750 vs 0.9586 / 0.9645) and is shipped; its test macro-F1 is 0.9749 (siblings 0.9695 / 0.9578). Chosen on val, never test.

inference_defaults.why: No dihedral TTA: 8 views x 40 patches is ~46 s per photo for ViT-B/16 on the production VM (docs/dinov3_integration_plan.md §6.2), and TTA for the frozen head is unmeasured (Screen D). Without it, model time is ~5.8 s per photo at 4 threads, parity with ResNet18 + TTA.

expected_performance.cross_camera_from_selection_folds: exp240-251, 3 seeds x 4 camera folds: patch macro-F1 0.8873 (3 ten-class folds), photo-pooled 0.9489 over 40 patches, no TTA
expected_performance.note: in-distribution only -- compare to the folds' test split and to allrigs_cam_s123's card, never to a cross-camera number

dino.experiment: docs/dinov3_integration_plan.md §9.1: all-cameras shipping fit of the selected cell
dino.head: sklearn LogisticRegression (L2, lbfgs) on standardised features at a FIXED C, exported to nn.Linear; the SGD-loop fields above (epochs, lr, optimizer, scheduler, ...) are unused
dino.C_rule: lower median of the per-fold val picks of exp240-251
dino.train_transform: eval transform (frozen arms get no photometric augmentation)

caveats: In-distribution metrics only; the cross-camera estimate comes from exp240-251.
Model time ~5.8 s/photo at 4 threads on the production VM (145 ms/patch x 40), parity with ResNet18+TTA, not a saving.
OOD guard must be rebuilt in this 1536-d space (reference + probe); the ResNet18 probe's 0.9681 threshold means nothing here.
The B/16 OOD feasibility check (plan §6.1) was saturated at AUROC 1.000 in both spaces with extreme margins -- the holdout verify is the real test.

ood_guard.reference: allrigs_dino3b16_s123.ood_reference.json (1536-d; per-photo training medians: median 0.954, p95 1.212, max 1.898 -- the centroid fallback's fixed 1.4 threshold is a ResNet18-space constant and would refuse some TRAINING photos here, so this model must ship WITH its probe)
ood_guard.probe: allrigs_dino3b16_s123.ood_probe.json, linear_probe. Threshold 0.5 (owner override 2026-09-27, the probe's decision boundary); calibrated threshold 0.0459 at certified alpha 4.3% (user_independent calibration, n=22), which remains a valid upper bound. At 0.5: dev 0/34 genuine refused, 82/82 negatives caught; holdout 0/22 and 56/56, but the holdout informed the choice. See the probe file's threshold_override.

holdout_verify_2026-09-27.negatives_caught: 56/56 (confusable_grain 26/26, other_nuts_seeds 8/8, green_legume 4/4, ground_coffee 6/6, empty_tray 4/4, non_food_objects 4/4, real_world_negatives 3/3, wrong_bean_type 1/1)
holdout_verify_2026-09-27.same_holdout_scored_by_the_deployed_resn: genuine refused 0/22; negatives caught 51/56 (missed confusable_grain 3, other_nuts_seeds 1, wrong_bean_type 1)
holdout_verify_2026-09-27.reading: Stricter in BOTH directions than the deployed guard. On the population the threshold certifies (user_independent) 1/15 is consistent with alpha<=4.3% at this n; the excess is internet-framed photos (3/5), a population the calibration never covered. Scores are saturated (most genuine exactly 0.0000, every negative 1.0000), so the threshold sits on a handful of photos. The holdout is spent: any change to the probe or its calibration now needs new holdout photos, not a re-run against these.
